title: Chapter 6882: More Summoning

Chapter 6882: More Summoning

Chapter 6882: More Summoning

Guardian Alliance was undeterred by the strong response from Stygian. After all, they had survived numerous battlefields before.

Moreover, they were far stronger than Devouring Alliance and didn’t fear the hidden threats.

“Haha.” Immortal Tun Ri laughed: “I’ll make it clear, we will flatten your world today. Come, summon all your immortals.”

“Our mission is the end of your alliance.” Blessed smiled.

“A purely suicidal mission if you dare to come in again.” Immortal Devouer said.

“Enough talk, let’s just fight.” The immortal with the bronze sword said.

“I feel the same way.” Bear Immortal added: “Let me summon more.”

“More?” Immortal Devourer and his allies had black lines on their forehead.

Guardian Alliance already had numerous immortals here. Could they handle more?

Sure enough, Bear Immortal shook his bell again. The ringing echoed across Heavenrealm.

“Shit, it’s another summon.” Mirage cursed.

“Come one-on-one!” Extinguish shouted.

“We want to destroy your alliance, not participate in duels.” Tun Ri laughed.

All along, Devouring Alliance never cared for honor. They preferred to gang up and devour the opponents. Alas, the tides were against them this time.

“Come fight us now if you dare, cowards.” Big-foot Immortal tried to bait them in.

“We will, once we get more people here. If you don’t like it, come out and fight us.” Tun Ri said.

“Boom!” Bright lights emanated from Grand Thousand World; one immortal appeared after another.

Even Heavenly Desolace erupted with light, building a direct path to Stygian.

“Heavenly Desolace!” Immortal Devourer became alarmed.

“Hey, aren’t you just summoning Guardian Alliance!” Big-foot shouted at Bear Immortal.

“Well, Heavenly Desolace is also a part of our alliance, not just Grand Thousand World.” Bear responded.

“Isn’t it the final fortress? Damn it!” Mirage cursed.

“Is Empress Hong Tian coming?” Immortal Devourer murmured.

Golden World, Ancient World, Epoch Dawn... immortals from these places paid keen attention to the new development.

“What is going on?” They observed the changes in the two worlds.

Guardian had dominion over two major worlds - Grand Thousand and Heavenly Desolace.

Only Golden Law and Heaven Assault Alliance could rival Guardian at this point. The once-weakest alliance had become the strongest.

It has been dormant after Enlightener’s dao proliferation. Now, even the so-called final fortress was on the move.

“Is Guardian Alliance attacking the heaven?” An immortal wondered.

However, the paths didn’t lead to the sky.

“No, they’re heading to Stygian.” Another said.

“Guardians, dao heart strong.” Immortals appeared from both worlds and walked on the path, shocking spectators with their majestic auras.

Among them was an immortal pulsing with a dao of truth and origination spanning from the past to the present.

“Qi Zhen. When was the last time we saw her?” One immortal remarked.

From Heavenly Desolate, another immortal was shrouded in the night and starlight, looking like the lord of stars.

“Nightfall Immortal Monarch.” An immortal in Stygian was vexed to see her since he had lost to her before.

A vine coiled up from Grand Thousand World, carrying an immortal exuding images of vines and flowers.

“Peashooter. Why did he join Guardian? I thought he hated them?” Someone whispered.

“Beaten to submission. Plus, he doesn’t have anywhere to go, might as well join Guardian, that’s better than being beaten everywhere.” An immortal said.

It didn’t take long before radiant immortals surrounded Stygian. Even Heavenrealm was being pressured by their surging powers.

“Haven’t seen this many immortals in a long time.” An overlord trembled upon seeing the gathered force.
